provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Welcome To... rules (Blue Cocker Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: A player sheet, a pen and a Player Aid each
3 random City Plans: one n1, one n2, one n3, Project side up; box the rest
Shuffle the Construction cards into 3 equal stacks of 27, house number up, with room for discards to their right
Solo: deal two equal stacks effect side up, shuffle the Solo card into one and put that stack under the other
Flip the top card of each stack; everyone picks a combination at the same time
